_note: Beat 6: the first step out in Hollow Rest. The four stand together on the map ('stage': 'huddle') while they talk, even in Solo.

steps.title: Morning
steps.text: The way off the island is the stairs at the front. Route 1 is below. Wild Patchlings live in the tall grass.
Weaken one, then seal it. The seal is a rhythm. Stay on the beat.
Callum's going to miss the beat.
I have rhythm. I make music.
"And I picked up a mic and I'm chill."
I will leave you in this world.
If your partners faint, come back to me. I fix things. Mostly.
